chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who bequeathed one-third of his wealth to his paternal uncles and maternal uncles, he عليه السلام said: “Two-thirds are for his paternal uncles, and one-third is for his maternal uncles.”
ai.seo_question: How is a bequest divided between paternal uncles and maternal uncles in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about dividing a bequest made in favor of paternal and maternal uncles. It states that when such a bequest is made collectively, the paternal uncles receive two-thirds and the maternal uncles receive one-third, reflecting their recognized legal weighting in kinship-based financial rulings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5483 - Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Ali bin Ri'ab, from Zurara, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who bequeathed one-third of his wealth to his paternal uncles and maternal uncles.
Imam (as) said: "Two-thirds are for his paternal uncles, and one-third is for his maternal uncles."
